resources.string: Sign in and check usage to get started. Everything below is optional. PC pairing is not required. Start medal and title collection separately with the Growth switches and confirmation. You can return here from Settings at any time.
This observation has an integer percentage. Decimal places are display formatting and do not add measured precision. Usage and remaining share the same server value.
This observation includes a fractional percentage. The selected decimal places only round the displayed value; stored observations remain unchanged.
